subject: Tideway: elevated latency & error spike — c-suite liaison and customer comms
messages:
From: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@tideway.health>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: support@tideway.health
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors and latency spike impacting checkout

Priya / Ben —

We just saw a sharp increase in 5xxs and 800–1,200ms tail latency for the Redwood inference calls powering our checkout personalization. Traffic is normal on our side; errors started at 08:50 PT and have persisted. Customers are reporting failed recommendations and abandoned carts.

I attached the earliest telemetry (tideway_initial_telemetry.csv) — request ids and timestamps included. Can your team confirm whether this is a model regression, routing issue, or infrastructure saturation? We are pulling exec attention on our end. Need an ETA and whether you can initiate any fallback (lower-tier model or regional routing).

Alicia Nguyen
Head of Product Operations, Tideway Health
alicia.nguyen@tideway.health
(415) 555-0192

[attachment: tideway_initial_telemetry.csv (CSV, 34KB)]

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@tideway.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Production errors and latency spike impacting checkout

Alicia —

Thank you for the telemetry. We're escalating to a critical incident now. Initial acknowledgement and immediate actions: 

- War-room: Standup in 10 minutes (09:35 PT) — invite going to your calendar; join link will be in the PD incident.
- Short-term mitigation: we will enable regional routing away from us-west-2 and activate a graceful fallback variant (reduced-context model) for checkout traffic if thresholds continue.
- Triage ask for you: can you share the volume of requests hitting the checkout endpoint (RPS) and any recent config changes?

I will ring in Ben and Marissa to lead operations and communications; Jonas will be on exec-liaison. We will push a customer-facing note within 60 minutes after the first triage checkpoint.

Attaching our mitigation playbook and the runbook pointer for the team to reference.

— Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
[attachment: redwood_mitigation_playbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Production errors and latency spike impacting checkout — ops triage

Quick ops update from initial triage (09:30 checkpoint):

- Observed: sudden drop in KV cache hit-rate for model X-3 in us-west-2 and sustained queue length on the inference pool (avg queue depth 42).
- Error profile: 502/504s concentrated on the recommendations path (model calls to X-3), correlated with a spike in concurrent sessions at 08:48–08:52 (consistent with Tideway's telemetry).
- Hypothesis: transient kernel contention on a subset of hosts combined with a cache eviction storm (likely due to longer prompts from recent UI A/B).

Immediate actions taken:
- Initiated routing rule to shift 40% of checkout traffic to eu-west-1 (can increase) and enabled the reduced-context model variant for checkout routes.
- Rolling restart on 6 affected workers in the us-west-2 pool — monitoring for recovery of KV hit-rate and error decline.

Next: monitoring window 09:45–10:00 to validate metrics. If errors persist, escalate to full capacity burst (reserve nodes).

— Ben Carter
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ops triage — exec briefing + customer comm plan

Scheduling note and exec invite:

- Exec sync: 10:30 PT (30 mins) — brief attendance requested: Jonas (CEO liaison), Grace (VP Product Ops), Priya (CS lead), Ben (Ops).
- Customer comms: Draft proposed for Tideway at 10:05 PT (short, transparent, next steps + ETA). I will own the send after Priya's sign-off.
- Action items before 10:05 PT: Ben — confirm whether queue depth is trending down after restarts; Priya — approve customer draft; Jonas — prepare high-level contingency options for the exec sync (credits, SLA exception, prioritized capacity).

Current pulse: after routing shift and restarts we see a 40% reduction in 5xxs but tail latency still elevated (p95 ~ 420ms, earlier was ~180ms). Continue monitoring.

— Marissa Cole
Director, Incident Response

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@tideway.health>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Tideway update (10:03 PT) — mitigations in progress and exec liaison

Alicia — quick customer-facing status: please review and confirm before we send. I kept it concise with the ask and ETA.

--- DRAFT CUSTOMER MESSAGE ---
From: Priya Natarajan, Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia —

We’re actively responding to the elevated errors and tail latency affecting Tideway checkout. Immediate actions we’ve taken:
- Shifted 40% of checkout traffic to an alternative region to reduce load on affected hosts.
- Enabled a reduced-context recommendation model for checkout to lower per-request resource use and reduce tail latency.
- Performed rolling restarts on a subset of workers in us-west-2 to restore cache health.

Status now: we’ve seen a ~40% drop in 5xx errors; tail latency remains above target (p95 ~ 420ms). Next checkpoint at 10:00 PT; we will escalate to burst capacity and coordinated kernel-level tuning if latency does not recover.

ETA and asks: we expect a clearer recovery signal in the next 30–45 minutes. Could you confirm whether you want us to flip all checkout traffic to the fallback model immediately (this reduces recommendation richness but speeds returns)?

We’ll send a consolidated update after the next checkpoint. Apologies for the disruption — we’re treating this as a critical incident and have exec visibility.

— Priya
--- END DRAFT ---

If this looks good I will send at 10:05 PT and continue to own comms.

— Priya

From: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@tideway.health>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: support@tideway.health
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tideway update (10:03 PT) — mitigations in progress and exec liaison

Priya — thank you. Please proceed with the draft and please go ahead and switch all checkout traffic to the fallback model now; better conversions at lower latency matter more in the short window. We appreciate the exec engagement and the fast updates — keeping our COO in the loop. Please share the 11:15 PT checkpoint metrics.

Alicia
Head of Product Operations, Tideway Health
